findings.claim: Stop word framing uses inconsistent bit counts: r1_answer_bits=6 vs payload_ids totaling 4 bits, r2_answer_bits=12 vs payload_ids totaling 8 bits, contradicting the stated payload structure and word-length definitions
Stop prefix lengths sum exceeds largest_prefix_before_action32 + margin: 63 (future_r4_STOP_prefix) + 51 (r2_STOP_prefix) = 114 > 70, breaching the largest_prefix_before_action32 bound of 70

recommended_next_step: Reconcile answer bit counts with payload_id widths and STOP prefix arithmetic against largest_prefix_before_action32 to resolve stated inconsistencies
summary: Two concrete inconsistencies identified: answer bit widths do not match payload_id enumeration widths, and STOP prefix length sums violate the largest_prefix_before_action32 constraint of 70.
